description: A local design system's button: everything eds.button is, plus an info tone. EDS deliberately ships no info button; this team needs one, and the info token ladder already exists — so the extension is five lines, and the merged contract is emitted and verified like any other.
notes: The ADR-0007 demo extension: enum values append, tokens interpolate over the extended enum, and the diff report records exactly one divergence from upstream.
